2. Explicit health of the excluded f(R) response
================================================
Choose H>0 and physical Jordan action

 f(R)=R-6H^2+R^2/(12H^2).

Vacuum de Sitter has R*=12H^2, f*=18H^2, F*=f_R=3,
f_RR=1/(6H^2), F*R*-2f*=0, and scalar mass squared 2H^2. Set the comparison
Einstein normalization M^2=3M0^2. TT perturbations have delta F=0 and
obey the entire calibrated GR tensor equation

 h''+2Hcal h'+k^2 h=2a^2 Pi_known^TT/M^2.                 (2.1)

This matches the measured kinetic normalization and known-matter source
coupling in the SAME physical Jordan metric, not only its dispersion.

The invertible local auxiliary representation is M0^2[FR-U(F)]/2, with

 R(F)=6H^2(F-1), U(F)=3H^2(F^2-2F+3).

On F>0 take g_E=(F/3)g and varphi=sqrt(3/2) M log(F/3). The Einstein
action becomes M^2 R_E/2-1/2(partial varphi)^2-V_E plus the known matter
action evaluated at (3/F)g_E. With z=sqrt(2/3)varphi/M,

 V_E=(3H^2M^2/2)(3-2 exp(-z)+exp(-2z))
    =3H^2M^2+(3H^2M^2/2)(exp(-z)-1)^2.                 (2.2)

At varphi=0 it has V_E=3H^2M^2, V_E'=0, V_E''=2H^2>0. Kinetic energy
is canonical positive, the scalar's principal cone is the null cone, and
the de Sitter minimum is locally stable. This is an actual finite-field
local healthy action about the selected background. It is outside (1.1)
because the physical metric action contains curvature coupling FR. The
Einstein-frame rewrite does not enter (1.1) with the same physical known
matter coupling: in that frame known matter is conformally coupled to
varphi. No observational fit or UV completion is claimed.
